# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 13 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 13
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But let us further inquire whether this people or the first people is the heir, and whether the covenant is for us or for them.
2. Hear then what the scripture says about the people: "And Isaac prayed concerning Rebecca his wife, since she was barren; and she conceived. Then Rebecca went out to inquire of the Lord, and the Lord said to her: 'Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples in your belly, and the one people shall have dominion over the other people, and the greater shall serve the lesser.'"
3. You ought to understand who Isaac signifies, and who Rebecca, and concerning whom he has shown that this people is greater than that people.
4. And in another prophecy Jacob says more clearly to Joseph his son, saying: "Behold, the Lord has not deprived me of your face; bring your sons to me so that I may bless them."
5. And Joseph brought Manasseh and Ephraim, wishing that Manasseh be blessed since he was the first-born. Joseph therefore brought him to the right hand of his father Jacob. And Jacob saw in the Spirit a type of the people that would come later, and what? And Jacob crossed his hands and placed his right hand on the head of Ephraim, the younger and second-born, and blessed him. And Joseph said to Jacob, "Move your right hand to the head of Manasseh, for he is my first-born." And Jacob said to Joseph: "I know, my son, I know; but the greater shall serve the lesser — and this one also shall be blessed."
6. See for whom he arranged for this people to be first and heir of the covenant.
7. If through Abraham even this was remembered and fixed from the beginning, then we are the people of the inheritance, the first people.
